issues.where: the swirling particles inside the sphere (also set-B-02.jpg crops 1-6 and set-B-03.jpg crop 7)
issues.what: motion blur is faked with stiff, straight white line and rod streaks layered over crisp, completely unblurred leaves and sharp pinprick light dots moving in the same current
issues.fix: remove the separate straight streak geometry and render true curved velocity motion blur consistently across all swirling leaves and light particles

issues.where: the crack on the upper-left glass above the cottage (also set-C-02.jpg crops 1-2 and set-A-02.jpg crops 3, 6)
issues.what: the crack is built from kinked straight polygon segments with one branch dropping down as a thick, ruler-straight white strip that terminates in a blunt square cut
issues.fix: replace the straight strip with a fine, irregular branching fracture inside the curved glass shell with internal edge refraction and tapered hairline tips

issues.where: the three carved pumpkin faces in the base (crops 8, 9, 10; also set-B-03.jpg crops 8, 9, 10)
issues.what: the glowing eyes and mouths are flat bright cutouts with no carved rind depth, and they cast zero warm glow or bounce light onto the adjacent dark vines, wax drips, or stone base
issues.fix: give the carved openings wall thickness into a lit hollow cavity and emit local warm light so surrounding vines, wax, and stone pick up orange bounce illumination

issues.where: the collar and wax drips where the glass meets the base (crops 9-12; also set-A-03.jpg crops 8-10)
issues.what: the sphere ends on a hard unshadowed line against the beige collar, black thorn cones clip straight through the collar without wrap, and the wax drips look like opaque plastic tubes intersecting the vines
issues.fix: seat the sphere in a recessed shadowed crease, resolve mesh interpenetrations with the thorns, and give the wax translucent subsurface scattering and pooled organic forms

issues.where: the interior scene near the glass wall (crop 5; also set-C-03.jpg crop 9 and set-A-02.jpg crop 3)
issues.what: only the thin outer glass rim refracts while the interior volume behaves like empty air, leaving the fence rails, cottage, and ground unbent and unmagnified right up to the inner wall
issues.fix: fill the interior volume with a continuous liquid refractive medium coupled to the inner glass surface so peripheral geometry bends and magnifies toward the rim

issues.where: what lies on the table surface, left and right (crops 11-12; also set-B-03.jpg crops 11-12)
issues.what: leaves meant to rest on the dark surface hover in mid-air at steep and vertical angles with empty gaps beneath them and no contact shadows
issues.fix: settle the exterior leaves onto the table plane with collision so their contact points touch their mirror reflections and cast tight occlusion shadows

issues.where: particles, leaves, and bats inside the globe (crops 1, 2, 3, 6; also set-C-03.jpg crops 7, 10, 11)
issues.what: leaves are razor-thin flat planes that clip straight through roof shingles, branches, and the right pumpkin face; bats at the top are flat 2D silhouettes; and foreground defocused particles appear as hard-edged flat opaque discs and pills
issues.fix: give leaves slight 3D curl, thickness, and collision clearance, model full 3D miniature bats, and render foreground defocus with true optical depth of field instead of flat discs

issues.where: the cottage windows, door, roof, and chimney (crop 6; also set-A-02.jpg crop 3)
issues.what: the green and purple windows are flat neon fills with unlit grid lines and almost no stone frame bounce light, the wooden door is a flat painted plane with no relief, roof shingles show striped shader aliasing, and chimney bricks are out of scale with the wall stones
issues.fix: add recessed window glass with lit interior depth and frame bounce light, model beveled door planks and hardware relief, fix roof shingle aliasing, and unify masonry scale

issues.where: the tree trunk and crown, fence, rocks, and pond shoreline (crops 7, 10, 11; also set-C-02.jpg crop 3)
issues.what: tree bark is a shiny stretched plastic wave texture with rigidly crossing stick twigs in the crown, the fence and shore rocks are boxy low-poly meshes, and stones meet the pond completely dry with no wet darkening or meniscus
issues.fix: replace shiny stretched bark and intersecting twig tubes with matte displaced bark and organic branch forks, add natural bevels and detail to fence and rocks, and darken wetted stone along the waterline

issues.where: the line where the base meets the surface and the mirror image (crops 8 and 10; also set-B-03.jpg crops 8 and 10)
issues.what: bottom thorns stab into the table plane while bright reflection bleeds under the unseated base, the mirror image stays nearly as sharp downward as at contact, and a straight-edged dark rectangular plane artifact cuts across the foreground reflection
issues.fix: seat the base foot flush with continuous contact shadow, stop thorns at the surface plane, blur reflections progressively with distance from contact, and remove the stray rectangular plane edge

issues.where: the outer glass rim silhouette and background bokeh discs (crop 4; also set-C-03.jpg crops 8 and 9)
issues.what: the high-contrast glass rim shows 1-pixel stair-step aliasing at native size, and out-of-focus background light discs have hard bright outer rings
issues.fix: increase anti-aliasing supersampling and highlight filtering along the glass silhouette and soften the radial falloff on background bokeh lights

issues.where: the dark upper-left and upper-right background corners (also set-B-01.jpg)
issues.what: faint concentric 8-bit banding steps appear in the darkest vignette gradient when inspecting shadow transitions closely
issues.fix: dither in 16-bit or add subtle fine grain before final 8-bit encoding
